project_type: .NET 10 backend solution with ASP.NET Core SystemAdmin host, MediatR CQRS, FluentValidation, EF Core, and xUnit integration tests
build_system: Finnova.Backend.slnx with project references; Finnova.Tests targets net10.0 and uses Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing, xUnit, EF Core InMemory, Moq, and FsCheck.Xunit
test_framework: xUnit integration tests through WebApplicationFactory plus existing unit/property tests
verification_instructions: Run the focused class with dotnet test Finnova.Tests/Finnova.Tests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~CustomerOnboardingApiTests, then the full Finnova.Tests project, then dotnet build Finnova.Backend.slnx. Do not change bin/obj outputs.
environment_constraints: Planning pass must not run build or tests. Backend worktree is e:/Finnova/Finnova-API. Frontend is a separate repository and is out of scope. Preserve existing uncommitted work; never reset or clean it.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, or root README was found. Preserve India-only, English-only, no-RTL product rules. Keep Customer master names as query-time projections and do not add raw document bytes or secrets.
key_patterns: SystemAdminAppFactory replaces SQL Server FinnovaDbContext with uniquely named EF Core InMemory and seeds rows in ConfigureServices. CustomerOnboardingAppFactory overrides only IIndiaAddressControl with IndiaAddressControlTestFake. SystemAdmin Program owns JWT/auth/middleware and AddFinnovaRepository owns repositories. Customer exceptions map to stable ProblemDetails codes in ExceptionHandlingMiddleware.
directory_structure: Finnova.Models contains contracts, entities, enums, and exceptions; Finnova.Repository contains DbContext, EF configurations, interfaces, and repositories; Finnova.Service contains Customer commands, queries, references, validation, and application ports; Finnova.SystemAdminService is the authorized HTTP host; Finnova.Tests/Integration contains WebApplicationFactory fixtures and API tests; .agents/tasks holds planning handoff artifacts.
known_findings: The clear-default handler already has the required Task return type. InMemoryNationalityRepository already implements GetActiveByCodeAsync. CustomerPorts duplicates repository interfaces, Customer application mapper/code-generator implementations are absent, projection is synchronous despite current-master lookup assertions, SystemAdminAppFactory lacks InMemory transaction warning configuration, and one test expects 400 while middleware maps the default-bank exception to 409.
